content.short: Realtime NFT rarity database, marketplace volume and statistics aggregation platform.
content.description: Our mission is to make information about Cardano NFTs free and available to everyone. Unlikely other platforms that charge to calculate rarities and create project pages, we do all this automatically right from the chain right when the assets are minted. We also offer a market data aggregation and statistics display with beautiful visuals. We show trends and are looking to develop a robust market movements and events notification system. Our mission is to make information about Cardano NFTs free and available to everyone.
content.meta: Find out about Jungle (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
